reason: In our trade people buy from people they know, and I've seen how a cold email from an unknown agency makes a supplier look desperate. I'd rather not put EUR 5,000 and my company's name on something I already doubt works, and the new country is next year anyway, so I'd look again then.
objection: That buyers in my industry will see us as spammers, and that one complaint about how they got their data lands us in GDPR trouble. Separate domains don't help if my company name is in the message.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three wholesalers like us I can call myself, who tell me it brought real meetings in a new country without hurting their name, plus a written GDPR basis per country, timed for when we enter the new market.
